retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s airbrushed graphic featuring geometric blue silhouettes against a vibrant sunset gradient with heavy architectural typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized, airbrushed composition featuring a cobalt blue silhouette of a lounging figure with sharp, angular outlines and soft internal gradients. The background is a vertical gradient from deep orange to pale yellow. The top third is dominated by heavy, blocky, custom-lettered typography with deep drop shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant orange-to-yellow background gradient contrasting with deep cobalt blue foreground
Sharp, geometric line work defining organic human forms
Heavy architectural typography anchored to the top left and center
Soft airbrushed highlights providing volume to flat blue shapes
coreInvariants: Deep red or maroon drop shadows on text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A stylized figure occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, lounging diagonally from bottom-left to mid-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized, heavy 'N' in the top left corner acts as a vertical anchor for the entire composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large red typography, move down the sharp white highlights of the figure, and follow the diagonal legs toward the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant provides open space for the gradient to breathe, balancing the heavy text on the left.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Maroon (typography shadow) and White (linear highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout; dark blue values in the foreground pop against bright yellow-white values in the center background.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tall x-height with compressed widths
Consistent stroke weight with no modulation
Deep, solid 3D drop shadows extending down and right
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'N' is oversized, spanning multiple lines of height
The 'S' and 'Z' are constructed from interlocking rectangular segments
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair heavy geometric display lettering with a wide-tracked, italicized sans-serif for secondary info.
graphicDevices: Thin white geometric 'straps' on the figure

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Art Deco revival height and weight
Required to match the specific interlocking 'S' and 'Z' shapes

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a blue geometric silhouette lounging against a vertical orange-to-yellow sunset gradient. Include thin white angular lines across the figure and a blue spiral hair element.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply heavy, tall, compressed red geometric lettering in the top left with a deep 3D block shadow. Add a secondary italicized sans-serif word in yellow on a dark red rectangular bar.

verificationChecks: Is the 'N' significantly taller than other letters?
Does the blue figure have soft airbrushed internal gradients?
Is the background a smooth vertical sunset gradient?
Are all corners in the typography and figure sharp rather than rounded?

Depth of the typographic drop shadow
mustRedesign: The exact facial profile of the figure
postGenerationChecks: Check for cobalt blue foreground vs orange background contrast
Verify the presence of the deep 3D block shadow on text
Ensure the figure is composed of sharp geometric segments
Confirm the airbrushed texture is smooth and grain-free
Check that the typography is vertically compressed and tall
